cases.name: plugins: liquidText generation needs a role
cases._note: CONTRACT, and the unauthenticated case throughout this group. A plugin route with a token would queue real work against the shared database, and firing it at both backends would queue it twice. What these establish is that a plugin route's role check is a DEPENDENCY, resolved before the handler body - there is no return value for a handler to drop - and a 401 here demonstrates that end to end.
